title: Best Smartwatch Under ₹5,000 in India (2026): AMOLED, GPS, Real Picks
description: Budget smartwatches have gotten genuinely good — AMOLED displays, built-in GPS, 7-day battery. Here are the 5 worth buying.
short_desc: AMOLED, GPS, week-long battery — the real picks.

headings.text: What actually matters in a budget smartwatch

cta.headline: Want a fitness-focused pick?
cta.sub: We ranked each watch by use case — fitness, style, battery, or call quality.

faq.a: Yes — many sub-₹5,000 watches now have built-in GPS (not just connected GPS). Look for 'built-in GPS' specifically if you want accurate run tracking.

faq.q: AMOLED vs LCD — does it matter?
faq.a: Massively. AMOLED is brighter outdoors, has true blacks, and uses less battery when displaying dark watch faces. Always pick AMOLED in 2026.
